items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: Earl was playing way before me... I saw the grandfather and the father.

ctx.x: Even as a kid you never heard of?

No. Earl was playing way before me, you know. He played with Emmanuel Perez around 1915. See I didn't leave here until 1917 with my parents. But I still had, I used to pass by the Humphreys, you know, and here they played. I saw the grandfather and the father.
They still had Cadiz and Liberty.
